camel_example: aliyun live ModifyLiveMessageUserInfo --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --UserId uid2
description_en: Modifies the information about a user
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-live-message-user-info --app-id demo --user-id uid2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLiveMessageUserInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application whose user information you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改用户信息的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose information you want to modify
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The additional information about the user after the modification. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节
parameters.name: user_meta_info

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2593195.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai）、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

schema.description_zh: 返回参数。如果修改用户信息成功，或用户不存在，则接口返回成功

FailList.description_en: The users whose information failed to be modified

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the group to which the user belongs. For failed modification, the information of the user is not updated when you query the users in the group. You can try again after you check the failure reason and fix the issue
GroupId.description_zh: 用户所在的群组ID。若修改失败，则在查询群组用户列表时用户信息不会同步更新。可根据失败原因检查后重新尝试

Reason.description_en: The reason why the information of the user failed to be modified
Reason.example: group not exists or already deleted

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the group to which the user belongs is modified. In this case, the group is not modified

SuccessList.description_en: The users whose information was modified

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the group to which the user belongs. For successful modification, the information of the user is updated when you query the users in the group
GroupId.description_zh: 用户所在的群组ID。若修改成功，则在查询群组用户列表时用户信息会同步更新

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the group to which the user belongs is modified. In this case, the group is modified
